findings.title: Monolithic production client bundle exceeds 500 kB chunk threshold
findings.description: Vite production build outputs dist/assets/index-DtB72mRC.js at 1,383 kB (347 kB gzip), triggering build chunk size warning. Large sub-studios (AnimationStudio, ImportModal, EncyclopediaView) are bundled in the initial entry chunk rather than code-split.
findings.impact: Low. Slightly increased initial page download duration on slow mobile networks; does not impair application execution or correctness.
findings.remediation: Configure dynamic import() or rollupOptions.output.manualChunks to split vendor and sub-studio components.

findings.title: External GitHub OAuth requires optional environment credentials
findings.description: The GitHub repository sync endpoint relies on GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET. When omitted, server returns HTTP 503 Service Unavailable gracefully with descriptive JSON.
findings.impact: Low. Core vector generation, editing, raster tracing, and code export work completely offline without external credentials.
findings.remediation: Documented in .env.example. Provide credentials if remote GitHub commit synchronization is required.

findings.title: Sliding-window IP rate limiter is process-memory resident
findings.description: Rate limiting uses an in-memory Map structure. Process restarts reset accumulated window counts.
findings.impact: Low. Fully sufficient for single-container Node.js deployment on Cloud Run. Multi-instance scaling would require Redis backend.
findings.remediation: If clustering across multiple container instances, wire an external Redis client to the RateLimiter interface.
